summary.intent: Run load tests with 10, 20, and 30 concurrent clients against the staging API, then scale up to find the throughput ceiling of a single staging instance, with detailed upload flow analysis via Prometheus metrics.
summary.outcome: Successfully established staging baselines for 10, 20, 30, 50, 75, and 100 concurrent clients (all zero errors), identified Kubo IPFS pinning as the dominant bottleneck (~95% of uploadFile latency), fixed two workflow bugs (Jest flag in Vitest config, missing GitHub environment declaration), and documented everything in the phase-19 baselines doc.

repo: The load test workflow at .github/workflows/load-test.yml triggers via workflow_dispatch with inputs: clients (int), scenario (string), environment (string).

Staging secrets (STAGING_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET, STAGING_THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET) and vars (STAGING_API_URL) are scoped to the 'staging' GitHub environment — the job must declare `environment: staging` to access them.
The `environment: staging` field causes GitHub Actions to label the job as 'Deploying to staging' in the UI — purely cosmetic, no actual deployment.
The load test suite has 5 scenarios: mixed-workload, upload-throughput, ipns-publish-storm, sustained-load, spike-test.
A single SDK uploadFile call makes 5 API calls: POST /ipfs/upload (ciphertext), POST /ipfs/upload (file metadata), POST /ipns/publish-batch, POST /ipfs/upload (folder metadata), POST /ipns/publish.
Baselines are documented in .planning/baselines/ following the format established in 18-performance-baselines.md, on a branch named docs/phase-19-baselines.
Release-please is active on this repo and triggers on non-chore commits; CI workflow changes should use chore(ci): prefix to avoid version bumps.

Prometheus metrics available on staging: cipherbox_ipfs_ipns_duration_seconds{operation='pin'}, cipherbox_http_request_duration_seconds{route='/ipfs/upload'}, cipherbox_ipns_publish_duration_seconds, plus IPNS publish batch counters.

code.finding: The test:single script used --testPathPattern which is a Jest CLI flag; Vitest uses positional args for file filtering. Fixed by removing the flag.

job.environment was missing, preventing staging-scoped secrets from being injected. Added `environment: staging`. Also had a 30-minute timeout that caused cancellations when all 5 scenarios ran at high client counts.

Using `pnpm test:single -- <scenario>` does not pass the scenario as a Vitest file filter (CAC puts args after -- into a separate bucket). Fixed by calling `pnpm exec vitest run --no-coverage <scenario>` directly.
Added concurrency group `load-test-<environment>` so parallel workflow dispatches queue rather than run simultaneously against the same staging API, which would corrupt results.

workflow: Running multiple `gh run watch` instances simultaneously (6 watchers at 3s poll interval = ~120 req/min) will exhaust the GitHub API rate limit (5000 req/hour) within minutes.
gh run watch can exit early when a deployment environment approval step is encountered, giving a false 'completed' signal before the job finishes.
Triggering multiple workflow runs simultaneously against the same API endpoint produces unreliable load test results; use a concurrency group to serialize them.
When a GitHub Actions job timeout is too low, runs are silently cancelled rather than failing with a clear error — check timeout-minutes when runs disappear.

friction: Initial load test runs failed due to two bugs: Jest flag in Vitest config and missing `environment: staging` on the job — required a PR fix before any valid data was collected.
gh run watch polling exhausted GitHub API rate limit when 6 watchers ran simultaneously, blocking status checks for ~1 hour.
gh run watch exits early on deployment environment steps, giving false completion signals and requiring re-watching.
All three 50/75/100-client runs were cancelled due to the 30-minute job timeout — all scenarios ran instead of just the selected one, taking 30+ minutes.
The rate limit hit during the cancellation investigation made it impossible to check run status, adding significant dead time.
The PR branch needed to be recreated with a chore(ci): prefix after the fact to prevent release-please from triggering.
open_items: The scenario filter fix (PR #340) resolves the 'all scenarios run' bug, but the 10/20/30-client baseline results in the doc were captured with all 5 scenarios running — only mixed-workload numbers were extracted, other scenario results were not documented.
Prometheus analysis of upload flow bottleneck is complete; next steps (faster Kubo storage backend, pin batching, concurrent pins) are identified but not acted on.
50 and 75-client Prometheus metrics were scraped and results committed but the exact numbers from those runs were not shown in the transcript — verify the baselines doc has complete data.
The 0.26% async DHT propagation error rate (324 errors) is fire-and-forget and doesn't affect clients, but warrants monitoring to ensure it doesn't grow.
Throughput scaling becomes sub-linear at 100 clients (5.4x at 10x clients) — the saturation point of a single staging instance has not been fully characterized; higher client counts could be tested.
